title: ITSE-2302 Data Streams, JSON, and XML Quiz

questions.question: Which of these means equal to? Choices: $a === $b; $a == $b; $a <> $b; $a = $b.
Which of these represents $a is less than or equal to $b? Choices: $a => $b; $a <= $b; $a =< $b; $a >= $b.
Which of these represents $a is not equal to $b? Select all that apply. Choices: $a == $b; $a >< $b; $a <> $b; $a != $b.
Data streams are long strings of characters formatted to convey information between systems. Choices: True; False.
Which are data streams? Select all that apply. Choices: JASON; SimpleXML; JSON; XML.

Which is true concerning data streams? Select all that apply. Choices: result in a compressed syntax to identify the information and its meaning; frequently used to transmit responses between the server and the user's browser; Must be complete, raw information; focus on the ability to quickly convey information in as readable a format as possible.

Which is true concerning JSON? Select all that apply. Choices: delimits objects with nested brackets and quoted values; acronym for JavaScript Object Notation; uses colons to denote value pairs; uses colons to separate value pairs.
Which is true concerning XML? Select all that apply. Choices: abbreviation of eXpandable Markup Language; similar to HTML; Tags are user defined; abbreviation of eXtensible Markup Language.
What does SimpleXML allow the PHP programmer to do? Select all that apply. Choices: Navigate XML content; Encode XML content; Create XML content; Edit XML content.
Which functions convert JSON to and from arrays? Select all that apply. Choices: json_encode; json_array; json_decode; json_extract.
